ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution shows a dominant high-intensity (white) core comprising approximately 75% of the visible surface, contrasted by low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated along the trailing edge and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity banding along the entire posterior boundary. Left lobe displays several curvilinear dark streaks originating from the trailing margin. Right lobe features a focal dark patch at the median notch and a sequence of 8-10 discrete vertical dark columns localized along the distal posterior margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern along the full trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks is most pronounced on the outer lateral margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge boundary follows a concave sweep trajectory from the median notch towards the distal lobe tips, which are slightly angled upward.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel diagonal linear pixel disruptions of tan-grey intensity localized on the ventral mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible linear diagonal scarring on the left lobe and distinct vertical pigmentation columns on the right lobe trailing edge.
